88176: Ritsu is a 2nd year high school student who lives in the same dorm with Usa. She is a seemingly shy girl who likes to read books. Her grandfather is brother to landlady of their dorm who views Ritsu as her relative.
88177: Usa Kazunari is a high school freshman whose parents had to move away for work. He agrees to stay anywhere, as long as he could live on his own in peace and quiet.
88178: The manager of Kawai Dormitory and the sister of Ritsu's grandfather. She interviews potential boarders first to determine background and compatibility with the current residents.
88179: An office lady who has terrible luck with men, she is the fourth resident that Usa meets. She is always spiteful to everyone, especially those who have found romance or are about to find romance. She tends to drink alcohol heavily when depressed and nags when drunk.
88180: Usa's somewhat perverted author roommate. Known for being a masochist, he specializes in bondage and can tie complex knots that are difficult to undo. He is good at crafting which he usually employs to while away boredom or make Mayumi feel better.
88181: A college student staying at Kawai Dormitory. She is the last resident that Usa meets. Sweet on the outside but loves to cause trouble for others, she has a penchant for leading men on. She loves to fondle Mayumi, much to the latter's resentment.
146936: She is Usa's former middle school classmate from West Junior High, where she was one of the oddballs who was associated with Usa. She later on changes her looks and attitude upon attending high school.
179173: Houjou is one of the first employees Usa meets at his summer part time job. Going by the name Yamamoto at work, he appears to have assumed the "apprentice" character rather seriously and uses lyrical, explanatory notations to emphasize his words.
179174: Kurokawa is also one of the first employees Usa meets at his summer part time job. Going by the name Saionji, he often speaks of guardian spirits which greatly reminds Usa of Hayashi.
179177: Sayaka's classmate back in middle school.
179178: Sumiko's friend and Usa's employer at his summer part-time job.
179179: An elementary school student who becomes attached to the Kawai Dormitory residents after Shirosaki found her wallet during a temporary falling out with her friends. She can be quite frank with her observations and can be unsparing when she speaks her mind.
